subtitle: Creating and populating all four dimensions

code:
INSERT INTO dw.DimProduct
  (ProductAlternateKey, ProductName,
   SubcategoryName, CategoryName)
SELECT p.ProductID, p.Name,
       sc.Name, c.Name
FROM Production.Product p
LEFT JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory sc
  ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = sc.ProductSubcategoryID
LEFT JOIN Production.ProductCategory c
  ON sc.ProductCategoryID = c.ProductCategoryID;
caption: LEFT JOIN keeps uncategorized products instead of silently dropping them.

eyebrow: A derived attribute, not a source column
code:
INSERT INTO dw.DimCustomer
  (CustomerAlternateKey, PersonID,
   StoreID, CustomerType)
SELECT CustomerID, PersonID, StoreID,
  CASE WHEN StoreID IS NOT NULL
       THEN 'Store' ELSE 'Person' END
FROM Sales.Customer;
caption: CustomerType doesn't exist in AdventureWorks2012 — it's derived once, here.
